spans.s: जघन n. 1. The hip and the loins, कृता जघने घने कलकलवती कांची Am.
, Bhartr.i.18; 2. the pudenda; 3. rear-guard, the reserve of an army.
जघन-कूपक m. du. the hollows of the loins of a handsome woman.
जघन-चपला f. a libidinous woman, पत्युर्विदेशगमने परमसुखं जघनचपलायाः Panch.i.
जघन्य (I) a. (f. न्या) 1. Hindmost, last, Bg.xiv.18; 2. lowest, vile, censurable, despised; 3. of low origin or rank.
जघन्य (I) a. (f. न्या) 1. Hindmost, last, Bg.xiv.18; 2. lowest, vile, censurable, despised; 3. of low origin or rank.
जघन्य-ज m. 1. a younger brother; 2. a Śūdra.
जाघनी f. 1. A tail; 2. the thigh.
